purpose: Acceptance specifications, not executable tests or proof of passing. Map to existing cases before adding duplicates.

cases.action: Child prints PASS and exits 7
cases.expected: Runner fails and records exit 7

cases.action: Only required case reports BLOCKED
cases.expected: Runner exits nonzero and preserves blocked status

cases.action: Select unknown suite, then valid plus unknown suite
cases.expected: Both selections fail before execution

cases.action: Select zero cases, then duplicate case IDs
cases.expected: Both inputs fail explicitly

cases.action: Child times out
cases.expected: Runner fails, stops only its child tree, retains output

cases.action: Child exits zero without the required verdict
cases.expected: Runner fails with missing verdict

cases.action: Child prints a valid passing verdict and exits zero
cases.expected: Runner passes with one executed case

cases.action: Parse defaulted FString declarations and both audited assertion styles

cases.action: Reconnect after session invalidation
cases.expected: Reconnect alone does not repeat the previous request

cases.action: Return explicit refusal, partial save, failed rollback
cases.expected: CLI exits nonzero using metadata, not prose

cases.action: Malformed or missing metadata from a migrated tool
cases.expected: Protocol failure, never success

cases.action: Body contains forged metadata-like text, then a valid final line
cases.expected: Only the validated final line determines outcome
